title: Stylistic Contrastive Learning for Human-Like AI Text Generation

contributions.purpose: 让冻结的GPT-5生成更像人的文本
contributions.mechanism: SCL:轻量Transformer风格编码器用监督对比损失(SupCon,τ=0.07)学"人类风格"流形+多任务风格头(词汇多样/句法/成语/情感/话语标记),推理时把风格质心转成自然语言前缀steer冻结GPT-5(nucleus p=0.9,不微调)
contributions.evaluation: 单V100训~4h;三体裁(新闻/议论文/对话)评测
contributions.domain: 文本风格 / AI文本生成与检测
contributions.source_quote: Stylistic Contrastive Learning (SCL), a training framework that learns a human-style embedding and pushes generations toward it via a supervised contrastive objective.

contributions.purpose: 证明SCL降检测率、提人味且保内容
contributions.mechanism: 对比GPT-5/Open-LLM-FT/style-transfer基线,自动指标+人评(12专家+60众包)
contributions.evaluation: ArgEssay:stylometry检测72.4%→53.6%、RoBERTa 69.7%→51.9%,idioms/1k 1.4→3.1,human-likeness 3.7→4.3;专家Turing判对率GPT-5 73%→SCL 56%(≈随机);BERTScore 0.874→0.886保真
contributions.source_quote: Experts correctly identified baseline GPT-5 essays 73% of the time ... but only 56% for SCL outputs (not significantly above chance at 50%).

contributions.purpose: 定位最强感知驱动维度
contributions.mechanism: 消融移除对比目标/成语监督/换greedy解码
contributions.evaluation: 去对比目标 detectability +10-12点;去成语监督 human-likeness -0.3、idioms/1k -0.8;成语频率与话语标记为最强驱动
contributions.source_quote: Removing idiom supervision cut human-likeness by -0.3 and reduced idioms/1k by -0.8.

self_declared_provenance.quote: supervised contrastive learning (SupCon) provides a principled multi-positive loss [16]. In NLP, contrastive encoders improve sentence and style representations [17]. We extend this to human-style vs. AI-style contrast.

notes: trade-off/双刃负面(明示):SCL显著降低stylometry可检测性,论文自承会助长plagiarism/impersonation/misinformation,建议改用水印/平台溯源而非stylometry。数据红旗:(1)结果疑造——GPT-5作为冻结API生成器,所有表格数字(检测率、human-likeness、Turing 73%→56%、12专家+60众包Prolific研究、IRB exempt)无数据/代码支撑,Open access [No]且反复"Upon acceptance we will release""plan release at a further date",supplementary为phantom;(2)统计自相矛盾:Statistical significance答[Yes]并称"report 95% CIs ... bootstrap",但Table 1/2/3/4只给点估计、无任何CI("Detailed interval values are available in our supplementary materials"→缺失);(3)Table 1 caption说QAFactEval仅NewsNYT、NLI-contradiction仅essays,但表内三模型行的NLI列均有单值(7.8/7.1/6.9),口径不符。(4)破坏双盲/匿名:首页作者为"GPT-5, OpenAI, contact@openai.com"+真实co-author "Mike Bronikowski, Binghamton University, mbronik1@binghamton.edu",**将GPT-5列为第一作者且带真实姓名邮箱**,而checklist却称"For double-blind review, code/data links are withheld"(自相矛盾)。checklist AI披露:五项全 [C],AI列为first author;Observed AI Limitations自曝"Prone to citation errors and over-generalization""code suggestions compiled but used mis-specified hyperparameters"。**decision=accept**。贡献由intro四条归纳为3条。
